user.title: Choose a UniFi Protect console
user.description: Pick the UniFi Protect console whose cameras should get watermark entities. This integration uses that console's existing sign-in.

abort.already_configured: This UniFi Protect console is already set up.
abort.no_protect: Set up the UniFi Protect integration first. It must be loaded and signed in with a local username and password, not only an API key.

protect_public_only.title: UniFi Protect has no private API access
protect_public_only.description:
UniFi Protect Watermark sets the watermark through Protect's private API, using the UniFi Protect integration's sign-in. That integration is set up with an API key only, or no longer uses a username and password, so the watermark can't be changed.

Reconfigure the UniFi Protect integration with a local username and password, then reload UniFi Protect Watermark.

no_supported_cameras.title: No cameras support the visible watermark
